consensus_summary: Gold standard lipid-soluble BHA with proven efficacy in penetrating sebaceous follicles to reduce comedones and acne lesions.
Proven in double-blind placebo-controlled clinical trials to improve epidermal barrier function, reduce sebum production, and inhibit melanosome transfer.
Essential physiological intercellular lipids required for stratum corneum barrier integrity and trans-epidermal water loss (TEWL) reduction.
High water-binding capacity humectant improving skin viscoelasticity and surface hydration.
Clinically proven dicarboxylic acid inhibiting tyrosinase and reducing Propionibacterium acnes colonization with anti-inflammatory efficacy in rosacea.
Triterpenoid saponins (asiaticoside, madecassoside) stimulate collagen synthesis and downregulate pro-inflammatory cytokines in sensitized skin.
Gold standard anti-aging and cellular turnover agents proven to upregulate collagen production and accelerate epidermal regeneration.
Essential preventative measure against UVA/UVB photoaging, DNA mutations, and hyperpigmentation.
